text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile CS Nambu Hai. 
Transcend tells her Trainer she gave away 
her data on the top contenders, but she 
doesn't seem the least bit worried.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A race organized with the help of many to 
keep everyone's hopes alive. Transcend 
burned with passion, eager to deliver that 
spirit to the disaster-stricken areas.
